findings.title: Incoming-character parameter mistaken for the occupying person

units.source: Twins: Я чувствую, что на мою сестрёнку посыпятся слова осуждений от этого человека.
units.currentTarget: Twins: मुझे लगता है वह औरत मेरी छोटी बहन पर तानों की बौछार कर देगी।
units.proposedFullTarget: Twins: मुझे लगता है उस व्यक्ति की तरफ़ से मेरी छोटी बहन पर तानों की बौछार होगी।

findings.reason: Current वह औरत / देगी specifies a female blocker. GetCharacterOnPlace("Alkonost") resolves the incoming Alkonost placement, then finds an existing occupant of that placement. Original CharacterSOData puts male Raskolnikov in the same default place 68; the previous adjudication premise that the returned blocker must be Alkonost is false.
findings.requiredRepair: Retain the predicted reproaches toward the younger sister, while referring to the actual blocker without assigning an unsupported sex.

findings.title: Raw dynamic label fails oblique agreement

units.source: Fanatic: Человек! СОЛНЦЕ велит не входить, покуда в доме таится {0}.
units.currentTarget: Fanatic: इंसान! इस घर में {0} के छिपे रहने तक सूरज ने मुझे अंदर आने से मना किया है।

findings.reason: The actual GetCharacterOnPlace("Fan") default domain includes Dude, whose approved/current UI label is ड्रेडलॉक वाला रस्ताफारी. Substitution yields ड्रेडलॉक वाला रस्ताफारी के छिपे रहने तक; वाला is direct-case masculine where the following के requires oblique वाले. The runtime returns the uninflected label and performs no Hindi inflection.
findings.requiredRepair: Use a construction that accepts the exact supplier labels of all actual occupants and retains hiding, the Sun instruction, and the until condition.

findings.title: Unchanged repetition still invents a handshake

units.source: Fanatic: Тебе кто-то рассказал, что я здоровался с самим СОЛНЕЧНЫМ ЛИДЕРОМ?
units.currentTarget: Fanatic: क्या किसी ने तुम्हें बताया कि मैंने ख़ुद सूर्य नेता से हाथ मिलाया था?
units.proposedFullTarget: Fanatic: क्या किसी ने तुम्हें बताया कि मैंने ख़ुद सूर्य नेता का अभिवादन किया था?

findings.reason: Russian здоровался is greeting; हाथ मिलाया specifies physical handshaking absent from source. The exact Russian repetition line:Fanatic_Photo_0a4e55d was correctly repaired in cycle 001, but this supplied repetition component still has the old error.
findings.requiredRepair: Apply the same greeting meaning in the complete repeated unit without adding a handshaking fact.

findings.title: Unchanged repetition narrows plural signs to one

units.source: Wheelchair: Если… если ты не доверяешь этому признаку, то как я могу им доверять?
units.currentTarget: Wheelchair: अगर… अगर तुझे इस लक्षण पर भरोसा नहीं, तो मैं उस पर कैसे करूँ?
units.proposedFullTarget: Wheelchair: अगर… अगर तुझे इस लक्षण पर भरोसा नहीं, तो मैं उन पर कैसे करूँ?

findings.reason: Russian им is plural and contrasts with этому признаку, whereas उस पर is singular. The exact source-equivalent cycle correction line:Wheelchair_Ears_DontShoot_02cee3c uses plural उन पर; this other supplied repetition retains the error.
findings.requiredRepair: Preserve the this-sign versus other-signs distinction in the full unit.

findings.title: Accepted repetition still reduces leave-alone request to physical touch

units.source: Widow: Делай что хочешь и не трогай меня.
units.currentTarget: Widow: जो चाहो करो, मुझे मत छुओ।
units.proposedFullTarget: Widow: जो चाहो करो, बस मुझे अकेला छोड़ दो।

findings.reason: In the Widow photo exchange, не трогай меня is a request to leave her alone; the scene concludes Теперь просто уйди. Current मुझे मत छुओ limits this to touch. The exact source-equivalent compiled row line:Widow_Photo_06bb696 was corrected, while this accepted serialized duplicate remains unchanged.
findings.requiredRepair: Preserve the leave-alone request consistently. Do not infer this accepted duplicate is runtime reachable merely because its source is repeated.

findings.title: Completed removal becomes only a collection attempt

units.source: FormerFema: Однажды я забрал очередного человека с признаками Гостя.
units.currentTarget: FormerFema: एक बार मैं अतिथि के लक्षण वाले एक और आदमी को लेने गया था।
units.proposedFullTarget: FormerFema: एक बार मैं अतिथि के लक्षण वाले एक और आदमी को ले गया था।

findings.reason: Russian забрал says the agent actually took the person. लेने गया था only says he went to collect him, leaving the removal uncompleted. This changes the established action in the later account of the detained man and his wife.
findings.requiredRepair: Retain the completed removal, the one occasion, another person, and Guest signs.
contextEvidence: paired-closure-fast.jsonl:closure index 968, complete unit and FormerFema account

findings.title: Discovery of Guest identity becomes a transformation

units.source: Bestson: А что, если бабушка оказалась Гостем и убила их? Что, если КЧС их остановили и забрали…
units.currentTarget: Bestson: अगर दादी अतिथि बन गई हों और उन्हें मार दिया हो तो? अगर आपात समिति ने रोककर उन्हें ले लिया हो तो…
units.proposedFullTarget: Bestson: अगर दादी अतिथि निकली हों और उन्हें मार दिया हो तो? अगर आपात समिति ने रोककर उन्हें ले लिया हो तो…

findings.reason: Russian оказалась Гостем is turned out to be a Guest. अतिथि बन गई हों says grandmother became a Guest, inventing a transformation rather than uncertainty about her identity. The second hypothetical emergency-committee capture must remain intact.
findings.requiredRepair: Restore the turned-out identity hypothesis without changing either feared outcome.

findings.title: Already formed or established identity is replaced with age alone

units.source: Experienced: А я уже человек состоявшийся, жизнь уже и так идёт к концу.
units.currentTarget: Experienced: मेरी उम्र भी हो चली है, ज़िंदगी वैसे ही ढल रही है।

findings.reason: Source first says he is already a состоявшийся person, then says life is near its end. मेरी उम्र भी हो चली है conveys only advanced age and loses the first assertion. The surrounding fixed cupboard, hardened habits and difficulty accepting new arrangements confirm the formed-identity contrast.
findings.requiredRepair: Retain the assertion of an already formed or established person as well as the separate nearing-end-of-life clause; avoid adding an occupation or economic-success claim.

findings.title: Avoidable masculine agreement assigns the ambiguous Death speaker a sex

units.currentTarget: मैं समझता हूँ, तुम तैयार हो।

units.source: Я уведу тебя в ночь, где сосна до звезды достаёт.
units.currentTarget: मैं तुम्हें उस रात में ले चलूँगा, जहाँ चीड़ का पेड़ तारे तक पहुँचता है।
मैं देख सकता हूँ कि तुम ‘हाँ’ कहोगे।

findings.reason: समझता, चलूँगा, and सकता mark Death as masculine. The approved Death meaning explicitly says poetic भाई and Russian она do not establish biological sex and contextual ambiguity must remain. These source verbs do not assign speaker sex. The two additional rows were read from actual compiled scene context, outside the supplied closure; they are not credited as supplied closure coverage.
findings.requiredRepair: Use natural neutral speaker constructions, preserving understanding, the definite promise to lead into the night, and seeing the anticipated yes. Keep source-marked player gender distinct from speaker gender.

findings.title: Full corrected unit retains masculine armpit adjectives

units.source: Buddy: Нечего тут смотреть, честное слово. Толстые, волосатые, да ещё и с грибком каким-то. Наверное, подцепил, когда с собакой ночевал на полу.
units.currentTarget: Buddy: देखने लायक कुछ नहीं है, सच कह रहा हूँ। मोटे, बालों वाले, ऊपर से कोई फफूँद भी है। शायद तब लगी जब कुत्ते के साथ फ़र्श पर सोया था।
units.proposedFullTarget: Buddy: देखने लायक कुछ नहीं है, सच कह रहा हूँ। मोटी, बालों वाली, ऊपर से कोई फफूँद भी है। शायद तब लगी जब कुत्ते के साथ फ़र्श पर सोया था।

findings.reason: The inspected referent is बगलें, feminine plural. मोटे, बालों वाले is masculine plural. Actual Buddy_Armpit inspection instructions and the preceding unit establish the referent; the later फफूँद ... लगी already uses feminine agreement. Correcting the dog term left this full-unit agreement defect.
findings.requiredRepair: Use feminine plural adjectives for armpits while retaining every other fact, the fungus and sleeping on the floor with the dog.

findings.title: Plain serialized service labels do not use the approved service term
findings.reason: All three accepted static labels have source Экстрасенсы and current साइकिक्स. This plain phone-service label has the approved term अतींद्रिय विशेषज्ञों की सेवा, also used in the table UI. These are plain service occurrences, not the source gag Гавнасэнсы; no wordplay exemption is evidenced. Serialized-placeholder visibility remains unproved.
findings.requiredRepair: Apply the approved service meaning to these plain labels; keep source wordplay variants separately adjudicated.

note: Objective meaning, agreement, dynamic-domain and approved-term issues only. Full replacements offered where unambiguous; author adjudication required. No authored input edited.
